judgments.rewrite_hint: “So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.” Narrow the claim to say that the test involved contract staff making calls without proper disclosure; do not assert what recipients believed. Reference: MUSE-HC-012.

“the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.” Limit this to the reported concern that sensitive information could be unintentionally shared with contract staff when needed for a call; do not state that private data was actually handled in every case. Reference: MUSE-HC-010.
